title: Amaziah of Judah and Jeroboam II of Israel

questions.question: Who succeeded Joash as king of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:1 (ESV): "...Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, began to reign."

questions.question: What did Amaziah do to the servants who killed his father?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:5 (ESV): "...he struck down his servants who had struck down the king his father."

questions.question: Why did Amaziah not put the children of the murderers to death?
options: Because of the Law of Moses (Deuteronomy 24:16)
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the Law of Moses (Deuteronomy 24:16)
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:6 (ESV): "But he did not put to death the children of the murderers, according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses..."

questions.question: Who defeated Amaziah in battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:12 (ESV): "And Judah was defeated by Israel..."

questions.question: Who reigned in Israel after Jehoash?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:23 (ESV): "...Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, began to reign in Samaria..."

questions.question: What parable did Jehoash tell Amaziah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:9 (ESV): "...A thistle on Lebanon sent to a cedar on Lebanon, saying, 'Give your daughter to my son for a wife.' and a wild beast of Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle."

questions.question: Where did the armies of Judah and Israel meet in battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:11 (ESV): "...and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another in battle at Beth-shemesh..."

questions.question: What did Jehoash take from Jerusalem?
options: Gold, silver, vessels, and hostages; he also broke down the wall
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, vessels, and hostages; he also broke down the wall
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:13-14 (ESV): "...and he took all the gold and silver... and hostages..."

questions.question: How long did Amaziah live after the death of Jehoash?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:17 (ESV): "Amaziah... lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash..."

questions.question: How did Amaziah die?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:19 (ESV): "And they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there."

questions.question: Who restored the border of Israel from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:25 (ESV): "He restored the border of Israel from Lebo-hamath as far as the Sea of the Arabah..."

questions.question: According to whose word did Jeroboam II restore the border?
options: Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet
questions.correctAnswer: Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:25 (ESV): "...according to the word of the LORD, the God of Israel, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet..."

questions.question: How many Edomites did Amaziah kill in the Valley of Salt?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:7 (ESV): "He struck down ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt..."

questions.question: Who succeeded Amaziah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 14:21 (ESV): "And all the people of Judah took Azariah... and made him king..."

questions.question: How long did Jeroboam II reign?

key_verse_text: He restored the border of Israel from Lebo-hamath as far as the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the LORD, the God of Israel, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath-hepher. (ESV)
